title: AI-Powered Ticket Categorization
story: As the AI Assistant, I want to populate classification fields from conversation data, so that fulfillers receive properly categorized tickets.

acceptanceCriteria.given: an incident is created from a conversation
acceptanceCriteria.then: Short Description and Description are generated from conversation content

acceptanceCriteria.given: the AI has high confidence in the classification
acceptanceCriteria.then: Category and Subcategory are populated automatically

acceptanceCriteria.given: the AI has low confidence in the classification
acceptanceCriteria.then: classification fields remain blank or are flagged for manual triage

acceptanceCriteria.given: a fulfiller reviews an AI-categorized ticket
acceptanceCriteria.when: they determine the classification needs adjustment

edgeCases: Conversation with no clear category match
Multiple categories applicable to the same issue
Category/subcategory combination not valid in the system
Description generated exceeds field character limits
